items.textToSpeech: Consumption of arabinoxylan as part of a meal contributes to a reduction of the blood glucose rise after that meal. The beneficial effect is obtained by consuming arabinoxylan-rich fibre produced from wheat endosperm as part of the meal.

The European Commission has authorised this claim for products which contain at least 8 grams of arabinoxylan-rich fibre produced from wheat endosperm (at least 60% arabinoxylan by weight) per 100 grams of available carbohydrates in a quantified portion as part of the meal. Is there anything else I can help you with?
